name: Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd.
summary: Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the shipping and real estate businesses in Japan, Saudi Arabia, and internationally. The company operates through: Overseas Shipping, Domestic and Coastal Shipping, and Real Estate Business segments.
